# VIRTURA SpacePort

VIRTURA SpacePort is the auto-guided app frontstage, themed release layer, station index, material-pack surface, and machine-readable layer for the VIRTURA network.

Long-term direction:
SpacePort is being developed as an auto-guided app frontstage for VIRTURA Creation Network. It should open mini apps, guided paths, release objects, material packs, media packages, and presentation tours instead of behaving like a flat website directory.
